info.title: ninjatune

post.summary: Search images and discover thumbnail URLs
post.description: Each result includes nullable `thumbnail_url`. GET it via the Media operation or use it in an HTML image. Thumbnails do not require `presign`. With `deduplicate=true`, total and pagination refer to query-specific pHash groups; matched_total counts images before grouping. Duplicates retain their own scores, labels, thumbnails and optional signed URLs. Compatible hash coverage may be incomplete on older indexes until backfill. pHash distance is not a probability or proof of identical files.

get.description:
Fetch a **pre-generated thumbnail** using the `thumbnail_url` from a search result.
Resolve that URL against the API origin, not the web page origin. No S3 credentials,
`presign` flag, model inference, or on-demand image processing is involved.

Only the index loaded by this server is accessible. The asset ID is opaque; do
not build it from S3 keys. Returns an inline still WebP with preserved aspect ratio
and maximum long side 512px by default. GET and HEAD are supported, as are ranges.

Successful responses use a strong ETag and
`Cache-Control: private, max-age=31536000, immutable`. Send `If-None-Match` to
revalidate (304). Unknown/unpublished/collected files return 404 with `no-store`.
Files are generated only during opt-in ingestion and can be collected after a
source ETag changes. There is no fallback to S3 or to an older source revision.

exclude_prefix.title: Exclude Prefix
exclude_prefix.description: Exclude keys starting with this literal, case-sensitive prefix within the included prefix scope, before other filters, ranking, grouping and pagination. Use a trailing slash to exclude a folder and its descendants, not similarly named siblings. Null or empty means no exclusion.

deduplicate.title: Deduplicate
deduplicate.description: Opt-in pHash primary-radius grouping of all filtered results before pagination. Missing compatible hashes remain standalone; old indexes may have no hashes. pHash can miss edits or group different images, even at distance zero. No source fetches.

complete.title: Complete
complete.description: All eligible images have compatible hashes, not an accuracy or dataset-wide uniqueness guarantee.

thumbnail_url.title: Thumbnail Url
thumbnail_url.description: API-relative URL of the pre-generated local WebP thumbnail. Resolve against the API origin and GET it (see Media), or use it as an HTML img src. Null when no thumbnail matches this indexed source revision. Independent of presign; no S3 credentials. Collected URLs can return 404; refresh search after an index update.

hamming_distance.title: Hamming Distance
hamming_distance.description: Bit distance to this group's primary.

total.title: Total
total.description: Eligible image count, or group count with deduplicate=true.

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.description: All assigned duplicates, in their original rank order. Not recursive and never silently truncated. Only present when deduplicate is true.
